data.one_liner: Flutter color manipulation and conversion library ported from JS tinycolor2
data.what_it_does: Provides utilities to manipulate, convert, analyze, and combine colors in Flutter. It supports operations like lightening, darkening, desaturating, spinning hue, mixing colors, and querying brightness or luminance.
use_when: You need programmatic color manipulation like lightening, darkening, or mixing in your app.
You want to extend the native Flutter Color class with helper methods for color adjustments.
avoid_when: You only need basic color constants and built-in Flutter Color and HSLColor features without helper chains.
You are looking for a complete UI theme design system framework.
strengths: Provides a rich chaining API for color modifications.
Extends native Flutter Color classes for cleaner syntax.
weaknesses: Limited to color manipulation and conversion utilities.
Relies on external packages like pigment for string parsing.
